summary_en: 422,000 shares (1.21% of S/O) to be acquired by open market over ¥500M limit between 2026/08/10 and 2026/09/17. Rationale: flexible capital allocation and 50% total payout ratio target, in addition to interim dividend of ¥32/share announced same date.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Fullcast Holdings announced on 2026/08/07 a board resolution to acquire up to 422,000 treasury shares (1.21% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) within a ¥500 million ceiling. The acquisition period runs from 2026/08/10 through 2026/09/17 via open-market purchase. The company states the rationale is to enable flexible capital allocation, achieve its 50% total payout ratio target, and improve capital efficiency, complementing the interim dividend of ¥32 per share announced the same day. As of 2026/06/30, the company held 400,073 treasury shares against 34,815,376 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
